sources.title: Sashank J. Reddi, Satyen Kale, and Sanjiv Kumar, On the Convergence of Adam and Beyond
sources.locator: §2 Algorithm 1; §3 Theorems 1–2; Appendices A and B; §4 Algorithm 2 and Theorem 4; Appendix D; Appendix F.
sources.detail: The full source setup and complete relevant proofs were inspected. The locally authored Adam proof proves both stated variants directly and repairs the Appendix F t=0 comparison by checking the first cycle separately; no unsupported bias-corrected guarantee is transferred.

sources.title: Elad Hazan, Introduction to Online Convex Optimization, second edition
sources.locator: §5.6 Algorithm 19 and §5.6.1 Lemma 5.13, Theorem 5.12 and proof.
sources.detail: Full monograph retrieved and inspected at the cited adaptive-regularization and online-potential arguments. AdaGrad is reused from the published library with its actual proof; the local AMSGrad argument is complete.

sources.title: John Duchi, Elad Hazan, and Yoram Singer, Adaptive Subgradient Methods for Online Learning and Stochastic Optimization
sources.locator: §2, Theorem 5 and its complete proof, including the diagonal adaptive regret specialization.
sources.detail: Full 39-page paper retrieved and relevant adaptive-gradient theorem and proof inspected as an independent research treatment.

sources.title: Léon Bottou, Frank E. Curtis, and Jorge Nocedal, Optimization Methods for Large-Scale Machine Learning
sources.locator: RMSprop exponential second-moment recurrence and coordinate update, PDF pp. 65–66.
sources.detail: Full 95-page paper retrieved; the complete RMSprop recurrence and coordinate rescaling passage was inspected.

sources.title: Diederik P. Kingma and Jimmy Ba, Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
sources.locator: Algorithm 1 and §§2–3, including moment bias correction and denominator placement, PDF pp. 2–3.
sources.detail: Full 15-page paper retrieved; Algorithm 1 and the surrounding bias-correction and epsilon convention were inspected to keep the local uncorrected variant distinct.
